_about: Real game SFX generated offline by the local MOSS-SoundEffect service (see scripts/gen-sfx.py). key -> { prompt (English text-to-sound description), duration seconds }. Tiny UI blips (tap, pling, flip, correct, match, soft) intentionally stay procedural Web Audio in AudioService.js — MOSS is foley/texture-oriented and noisy for crisp musical blips. These textured + animal sounds are where real samples win. Anything missing here falls back to the synth (or, for animals, to spoken onomatopoeia).
